newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas dips in summer, winter offered dow.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas dips in summer, winter offered dow.

text.p: IPE natural gas prices dipped in the prompt month July in the morning session on Wednesday while the first quarter next year was offered lower in the face of non-existent buying interest.
A total of just 20 lots were traded, 10 in July which slipped 0.20 pence per therm (p/th) to 10.30 p/th, and 10 in September which also dipped 0.2 p/th to 10.50 p/th.

The market has come under pressure with new supplies of gas from the North Sea J-block expected to start flowing in July after Enron lost its court battle with the J-block producers earlier this week.
"The market is looking like it's going to be well supplied," said one broker.
Lower offers were posted in all three months at the first quarter of next year but no bids emerged.
